rationale: diffusion_recon_dcstep_unconstrained_mayo_v4-claude-agentic: recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/ddpm_mayo_unconstrained_v4.pt, recon_mode=dps, recon_sample_steps=56, recon_eta=5.0, recon_init=fbp, recon_eta_clamp=False, recon_dcstep_every=5, recon_dcstep_n_cg=3, recon_dcstep_warmup=5, recon_dcstep_relax=1.0, recon_dc_solver=cg, val_n=96, train_n=0, rationale=iter-7 search-20260619-01 UNCONSTRAINED diff-recon -- AUTHORIZED audit-fix (B) part (i): RAISE THE NFE KNOB. ONE KNOB: recon_sample_steps (T, DDIM reverse-step count = NFE) 40->56 (+40% finer DDIM grid); val_n 120->96 evenly-spaced is the BUDGET-SIZING co-move (box 5, the single authorized (B) val_n exception to hold the HARD 1200s wall), NOT a hypothesis variable. BASE = iter-6 (the A-fix CG-DC working point, BEST SSIM 0.8241): recon_dc_solver=cg, recon_dcstep_every=5, recon_dcstep_n_cg=3, recon_dcstep_warmup=5, recon_dcstep_relax=1.0, recon_eta=5.0, recon_init=fbp, recon_eta_clamp=false ALL UNCHANGED. The (A) DC-step CG fix already landed iter-6 (the unconstrained variant got the biggest A-fix gain: soft-DPS best 0.3960 -> CG-DC 0.8241). The (B) v5 DDPM retrain (part ii: full train pool + EMA + DPS-recon selection) is NOT ready -- this iter changes ONLY the NFE knob, reusing ddpm_mayo_unconstrained_v4.pt (200 train slices, NO retrain; "unconstrained"=200-slice misnomer from the demo-dl phantom regime, NOT a leakage variant). TRAJECTORY (val L277, 321px detector-geometry FOV, LD-FBP floor 0.8078): iter-1 T25/eta30/every0 SSIM 0.3688/hr0; iter-2 eta30->5 SSIM 0.3960/hr0 (best soft); iter-3 T25->32 SSIM 0.3869/hr0; iter-4 every0->5 LEGACY hard-DC SSIM 0.0553 (collapse); iter-5 T->40 soft SSIM 0.3709/hr0; iter-6 recon_dc_solver=cg CG-DC SSIM 0.8241/hr0/PSNR27.15 (BEST, the A-fix). LIMITER: regime-bounded on DENSE 2304-view rebinned Mayo -- LD-FBP is near-complete so hr>0 is unlikely from a finer DDIM grid; the coarse T=40 grid is the remaining soft lever and the v4-prior payoff is the 128-view SPARSE benchmarks (not this dense-Mayo iter). HYPOTHESIS: a finer DDIM reverse schedule (T 40->56, +40% NFE) lets the CG-DC iterate relax more completely onto the sino-consistent mode, lifting SSIM modestly above iter-6 BEST 0.8241 -- predicted 0.83-0.85, hr STAYS 0 (regime-bound). NUMERIC FALSIFIER: if SSIM <= 0.8241 (flat-or-down vs iter-6) at T=56, the NFE lever does NOT help on dense Mayo -- T has saturated on the CG-DC path; file it, unconstrained best stays iter-6 (SSIM 0.8241, hr 0), and the NFE lift (if any) is reserved for the SPARSE benchmarks where the prior matters. BUDGET (HARD 20-min=1200s wall, val=evenly-spaced L277): iter-6 ran 961.6s at T=40/val_n=120 = 8.013 s/slice = 0.2003 s/slice/step (CG-DC cost grows ~linearly with T since both DDIM steps and the every-5 CG triggers scale with T). At T=56: 56*0.2003 = 11.22 s/slice; val_n=96 -> 96*11.22 = 1077s = 18.0 min < 1200s (~2 min headroom). val_n=120 at T=56 would be 1346s=22.4min (BLOWS the wall), so val_n=96 is the budget mechanism that unlocks the +40% NFE probe, evenly-spaced across the 214-slice L277 volume (protocol-sanctioned when val_n<214). HARD-WIRED: staged_canonical data, v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geometry, per-sample-ps single-val-ps probe, bg_target=truth, 321px detector-geometry FOV default (no fov=False), recon_dc_solver=cg. reuse ddpm_mayo_unconstrained_v4.pt (NO retrain).
